title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a save, publish or rollback naming a read-only base itself onto its view, dashboard, report, translation or email template is refused, naming the .custom pair
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9AsaLgYRYhj5jx2ydBPLnyA)_
Fixes #28905

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none needed — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s ADR-0146 paragraph already places every customization of an installed base in its paired `.custom`, declaring `overrides`, and names `?package=BASE` only as a read that serves it; nothing it says becomes false.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：保存、发布（单项与 publish-drafts 批量）、回滚时直接写 `?package=只读基础包` 到它自带的视图、仪表盘、报表、翻译或邮件模板，现在一律 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`，提示改写进它的 `.custom` 配对包并声明 `overrides`——与 #28576 对“不写包名”的拒绝同一句修复。删除保持开放。
- 为什么改：ADR-0146 D1 规定只读包的定制只落在配对包里；但写基础包本身仍会落下一行未声明的定制，盖住基础包文档、不随配对包导出，迁移仪式 `os migrate packageless-overlays` 也看不见它。
- 风险与回滚：仅收窄写入口，不改存量行：以前这样存下的行照常生效，可删除，或被配对包声明的覆盖压过。回滚即撤销本 PR。另：`os migrate organization-ownership --apply` 把公开表单撤回带到代码包视图时，现会停下报阻塞并给出配对包写法。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`（`namedBaseCloseSubject` 的放行条件与句子）、`protocol.ts` 中 `promoteDraftForPublish` 的新判定（批量发布整批中止）、`protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/metadata-protocol && npx vitest run src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts`，应见 17 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`@objectstack/metadata-protocol` — an authoring write that names the read-only code package itself (`?package=BASE`) onto an item of one of the five overlay types that package ships is now refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, writes nothing, and names the fix the package-less close (#28576) names, in the same words: write it into `BASE.custom` (`?package=BASE.custom`), declaring `overrides: { package: 'BASE', basedOn }`.

- **Closed:** the save (draft and active), the per-item publish and `publishPackageDrafts` (both through `promoteDraftForPublish`, judged on the package the active row is written under; the batch aborts all-or-nothing and `failed[]` names the item), and the rollback of a row bound to the base.
- **Closed only where the fix can be taken** — `namedBaseCloseSubject`, which reads "packaged" exactly as the package-less close does (`overlayBaseShippers`, read-only shippers of the five types), with the named package among the shippers, and then checks the same steps: a pair id derives, the ensure door would not refuse the pair, the base records a version, and the override write gate admits the declared body into the pair. Anything else keeps the write it has on `main`.
- **Kept open:** a delete naming the base and its draft discard (removing a row writes nothing, and it is the only way to clear a row stored before this change); a writable package; a name the base does not ship (ADR-0070 D1's `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`); a body carrying `overrides` (the D2 gate's `declared_outside_pair` sentence, unchanged); a base whose pair cannot be ensured or that has no version; an `email_template` locale the base does not ship; and the server-stated rewrites (`source` set, `package-duplicate`).
- **One spelling:** `closedOverlayWriteClauses` now builds the item / base / pair / declaration / fix clauses for both closes. `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`'s output is byte-identical (its pins in `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`, `protocol.packaged-base-refusal.test.ts` and objectql's five-types file are unchanged and green). Only the rule clause after the fix differs.

The sentence, save of `view/task.crm_list` naming `com.acme.crm` (358 characters, against 382 for the package-less save of the same item; a 30-character base id with a 40-character name stays under 500 on every verb, pinned):

> 'view/task.crm_list' ships in 'com.acme.crm': save it into 'com.acme.crm.custom' (?package=com.acme.crm.custom), declaring overrides: { package: 'com.acme.crm', basedOn }. The read-only base itself takes no customization (ADR-0146 D1, D11): a row bound to it from before is served until the pair declares the override, or a delete naming the base removes it.

## Measured before the change (origin/main 14208f2c, stub engine, five types)

| Door naming `?package=BASE` | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| save, active | accepted: an undeclared row bound to BASE, served by the read naming no package and by `?package=BASE` in place of BASE's document | refused 403, nothing written |
| save, draft | accepted | refused 403 |
| per-item publish | accepted | refused 403, draft stays a draft |
| `publishPackageDrafts(BASE)` | promoted the draft (`outcome: published`) | `outcome: refused`, `failed[0].code` `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` |
| rollback of a row bound to BASE | accepted | refused 403, row unchanged |
| delete naming BASE | removes the row; the pair's row (if any) is served | unchanged (open) |
| ceremony census (`listPackagelessOverlays`) | lists none of these rows | unchanged (out of scope) |

A pair row declaring the override beside a row bound to BASE is served over it (read naming no package, `?package=BASE`, layered `effective`), so the refusal's fix works for rows stored before.

## Tests

- New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.named-base-overlay-write.test.ts` (17 cases): the save naming the base, active and draft, for each of the five types; the per-item publish; `publishPackageDrafts`; the rollback; the 500-character bound at a long base id and name; and the controls: delete and draft discard naming the base stay open; the pair's declared save is accepted and served over a row bound to the base; a `migrate-stored` rewrite still writes; a writable package's same name; a name the base does not ship keeps `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`; a base whose pair cannot be ensured keeps the write; a body carrying `overrides` keeps the D2 sentence.
- `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`: one real-engine case per type and topology (10): the save naming the read-only package, active and draft, is refused naming its pair and stores nothing.
- **Forced test edits** (each wrote through the door this change closes):
  1. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts` › "an item a CODE package ships…" › "with an overlay row bound to the code package: the package-less save is refused, and that row is untouched". It seeded that row with `saveMetaItem({ packageId: CODE_PACKAGE })`. It now asserts that save is refused (403, names the pair, nothing written), then seeds the row directly (`seedRow`) as a build before this change left it. The rest of the case is unchanged.
  2. `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts` › "the package-batch doors and the cluster fan-out carry the member (#22877, stage 2)": four cases drafted `email_template` members into the read-only `com.acme.mail` itself and then asked `publishPackageDrafts` / `revertCommit` / `discardPackageDrafts` / `listDrafts` / `listCommits` of it. They now draft into its pair, declaring the override, and ask the same doors of the pair. Every member assertion is unchanged (35/35).
  3. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` (landed with #29090 today) › its last control drafted a showcase view into `com.example.showcase` itself to give the read-only package a commit. It now asserts that draft is refused naming the pair. It then writes the same customization into `com.example.showcase.custom`, declared, and pins the commit's revert through the pair's own path, and through no other (404 through B, 200 and `removed` through the pair). Its header says why: a commit recorded before keeps its revert, since the commit doors still take no read-only guard, but a fresh boot can no longer make one.

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

1. Save door throw removed (`if (namedBase) throw namedBase;` after the save's close): 6 red — the five per-type save cases and the forced pin (`Error: expected the call to be refused, but it resolved`; the report case got `422` from a later gate instead).
2. Promotion throw removed: 2 red — per-item publish (`expected undefined to be an instance of Error`) and `publishPackageDrafts` (`expected { success: true, …(7) } to match object { success: false, …(3) }`).
3. Rollback throw removed: 1 red — the rollback case.
4. The `overrides` exclusion removed: 1 red — the D2 control (`expected "'view/task.crm_list' ships in 'com…" to contain "only 'com.acme.crm.custom' may decl…"`).
5. objectql real-engine pin, against the metadata-protocol dist: save throw neutralised with a marker, dist rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` saw the marker in 2 built files: 10 red / 26 green of 36 (`publish: expected undefined to match object { Object (code, status) }`). Restored, dist rebuilt, preflight `--absent` saw the marker in none of 24 built files, tree clean.
6. Dogfood pin (forced edit 3), against the metadata-protocol dist the boot consumes: same neutralised throw, marker present in 2 built files: 1 red / 6 green (`{"success":true,…,"message":"Saved customization overlay (env-wide, package=com.example.showcase, state=draft) …"}: expected 200 to be 403`). Restored, rebuilt, marker absent, tree clean.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Delete stays open, on purpose.** D1's closed writes are the ones that write a row. A delete naming the base writes none and is the one way to clear a row stored before this change, because `os migrate packageless-overlays` lists package-less rows only and never sees one.
- **Rows already stored bound to a read-only base** (reach, census): they are served at the base's address and by the read naming no package, in place of the base's document, until the pair declares the override or a delete naming the base removes them. The ceremony does not list them. Census on a deployment: rows of `sys_metadata` whose type is one of the five and whose `package_id` is a read-only code package that ships the name. I could not take a census of a real deployment from here. Not widened into the ceremony (#28904 is in that file).
- **`os migrate organization-ownership --apply`** (read from code, not run): `carryFormWithdrawals` saves the withdrawal onto a code-shipped view naming its served package, which is the base. That save is now refused, so the ceremony reports a fail-closed blocker quoting this refusal. The operator saves `sharing.enabled: false` into the pair, declaring the override, then re-runs. Its cli tests use a stub door, so they stay green. The changeset says so too.
- **Duplication:** `namedBaseCloseSubject` repeats the pair, ensure, version and gate steps of `packagelessCloseSubject`. That function lives in `protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`, which this card stays out of while #28904 is open. Folding the two predicates into one is a follow-up for after #28904 lands.
- **`email_template` at a locale the base does not ship** stays open here, as it does for the package-less close (the gate refuses the declared body in the pair; #28904 covers that move).
- **ADR-0087:** disposed `not-required (already-registered packageless-overlay-write-closed)`. That entry has not been released and ships in the same release. Its replacement — write the customization into `BASE.custom` with the declaration — is this change's TO. Its surface text names the package-less write only, and widening it is a `packages/spec` edit outside this lane.
- The `package-less` sentence (#28576, unchanged here) passes 500 characters at a 30-character base id with a 40-character name (510 on save). Noted, not changed.
